responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module exports the location_t and diagnostic services implemented by m2linemap.cc. It declares the procedures for starting and ending files and lines, constructing source locations and ranges, querying file/line/column data, and issuing errors, warnings, notes, and internal errors through GCC’s diagnostic framework from Modula-2 code.
same_name_distinction: Modula-2 definition module for the m2linemap group: it defines location_t and exports the source-location and diagnostic procedures for Modula-2 callers, unlike m2linemap.h's C declarations and m2linemap.cc's concrete adapter code.
